package serial

import (
	"sync"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

type probeConfigMutex struct{ sync.Mutex }

func (m *probeConfigMutex) Lock() {
	if m.Mutex.TryLock() {
		return
	}
	probeState.contention <- struct{}{}
	m.Mutex.Lock()
}

var probeState struct {
	sync.Mutex
	dcb            windows.DCB
	armed          bool
	gets           int
	sets           int
	firstWrite     chan struct{}
	releaseFirst   chan struct{}
	secondSnapshot chan struct{}
	contention     chan struct{}
}

func probeReset() {
	probeState.Lock()
	defer probeState.Unlock()
	probeState.dcb = windows.DCB{}
	probeState.armed = false
	probeState.gets = 0
	probeState.sets = 0
	probeState.firstWrite = make(chan struct{})
	probeState.releaseFirst = make(chan struct{})
	probeState.secondSnapshot = make(chan struct{})
	probeState.contention = make(chan struct{}, 1)
}

func probeCreateFile(_ *uint16, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ *windows.SecurityAttributes, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ windows.Handle) (windows.Handle, error) {
	return 400, nil
}

func probeGetCommState(handle windows.Handle, dcb *windows.DCB) error {
	if handle != 400 {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	probeState.Lock()
	defer probeState.Unlock()
	*dcb = probeState.dcb
	if probeState.armed {
		probeState.gets++
		if probeState.gets == 2 {
			close(probeState.secondSnapshot)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func probeSetCommState(handle windows.Handle, dcb *windows.DCB) error {
	if handle != 400 {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	probeState.Lock()
	first := false
	if probeState.armed {
		probeState.sets++
		first = probeState.sets == 1
	}
	probeState.Unlock()
	if first {
		close(probeState.firstWrite)
		<-probeState.releaseFirst
	}
	probeState.Lock()
	probeState.dcb = *dcb
	probeState.Unlock()
	return nil
}

func probeSetCommTimeouts(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.CommTimeouts) error { return nil }
func probeCloseHandle(_ windows.Handle) error                              { return nil }
func probeCancelIoEx(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.Overlapped) error        { return nil }
func probeCreateEvent(_ *windows.SecurityAttributes, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ *uint16) (windows.Handle, error) {
	panic("unexpected CreateEvent")
}

func probeReadFile(_ windows.Handle, _ []byte, _ *uint32, _ *windows.Overlapped) error {
	panic("unexpected ReadFile")
}

func probeWriteFile(_ windows.Handle, _ []byte, _ *uint32, _ *windows.Overlapped) error {
	panic("unexpected WriteFile")
}

func probeGetOverlappedResult(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.Overlapped, _ *uint32, _ bool) error {
	panic("unexpected GetOverlappedResult")
}
